details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B is the base (pretrained, non-instruction-tuned) checkpoint in Alibaba's Qwen2.5-Coder code-model family: a 3.09-billion-parameter (2.77B non-embedding) transformer with grouped-query attention across 36 layers, trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data. Released by Qwen on November 12, 2024 as part of the family's expansion beyond the original 1.5B/7B sizes, it is meant as a foundation for further fine-tuning or completion-style use rather than direct conversation; Qwen's own model card states 'we do not recommend using base language models for conversations.' Unlike most other Qwen2.5-Coder sizes, this checkpoint is released under a Qwen Research license rather than Apache 2.0.
advantages: Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens including source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data, per Qwen's model card.
Uses grouped-query attention (16 query heads, 2 key-value heads) across 36 layers for efficient inference at 3B scale, per Qwen's model card.
One of six sizes (0.5B-32B) in the Qwen2.5-Coder family, giving a low-resource entry point for code-focused pretraining or fine-tuning.
disadvantages: This is a base, non-instruction-tuned checkpoint; Qwen's model card states base language models are not recommended for conversations without further post-training such as SFT or RLHF.
Text-only; Qwen's model card and the catalog facts list no vision or audio input.
Released under a Qwen Research license, more restrictive for commercial use than the Apache 2.0 license Qwen uses for other Qwen2.5-Coder sizes.
use_cases: Base checkpoint for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or RLHF into custom coding assistants
Foundation for building coding agents and downstream applications, per Qwen's model card

notes: No numeric benchmark scores for this specific 3B size are shown in text on Qwen's model card or the Qwen2.5-Coder blog (the blog only shows size-vs-score charts, not tabulated numbers), so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. Qwen's GitHub repo for Qwen2.5-Coder now redirects (HTTP 301) to QwenLM/Qwen3-Coder, so no working github_url could be confirmed; left null. Release date corrected to November 12, 2024 (the family's four-size expansion announcement): the HF repo's first commit is Nov 8, 2024, and the September 2024 date on the model card lineage actually belongs to the earlier 1.5B/7B release wave.
